deadline.value: January 24 for the May 1 or September 1 start, for domestic and international applicants; later applications only in exceptional circumstances.
deadline.quote: Deadline is January 24 for the May 1 or September 1 start date.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked

supervisor.value: Finding a supervisor is called essential to a successful admission, so contact faculty early.
supervisor.quote: Finding a supervisor is essential to being successful in our admission process for our thesis-based graduate programs

funding.value: PhD students within their expected completion time are guaranteed full tuition plus CAD 18,200 per year (conditional on progression and a 78% average).
funding.quote: All students in the Ph.D. program who are within their expected completion time are guaranteed a minimum of full tuition (excluding fees) (whether domestic or international) plus an additional $18,200 per year.

entry_route.value: A Master's degree with at least 70% and evidence of research potential (78% to be eligible for departmental funding).
entry_route.quote: Master's degree or equivalent from a university, college or institute, and provide evidence of research potential.

ielts_min.value: Earth Sciences asks for IELTS 6 overall with no band below 6, lower than the graduate-school 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum acceptable score is 6 out of 9 with no individual score falling below 6.

english_waiver.value: The department can waive the English test after at least one year at an accredited university taught in English; waivers are case-by-case and not guaranteed.
english_waiver.quote: We can offer a waiver of the English proficiency test when the applicant has completed at least one year of study at an accredited university where English is the medium of instruction. Waivers are not guaranteed and are judged on a case-by-case basis.

notes: Geology and Geophysics PhDs are run by this department; the Geophysics listing (graduate school program page 67) has the same deadline and IELTS but states TOEFL 92.
